present.label: Read the input
present.story: {n} guests will arrive. We want to know whether any number shows up twice.
present.formal: nums has {n} values. Return True if any value repeats.

add.label: Check and add
add.story: Guest {i} wears {value}, which is not on the list yet. Add it; the list now has {size} numbers.

duplicate.label: Repeat found
duplicate.story: Guest {i} wears {value}, and {value} is already on the list from position {first}. Someone came twice.

all-unique.label: All different
all-unique.story: All {n} guests are checked and no number appeared twice.
all-unique.formal: Loop finished with no repeat. Return False.
